notes: Audio dimensions removed from VLM judge — qwen-vl-max cannot hear audio. Audio checks moved to L1 deterministic verifier (audio stream exists, silencedetect).

dimensions.name: brief_adherence
dimensions.description: Does the final video follow the creative brief? Check theme, mood, style, required elements, aspect ratio, duration range.

anchors.4: Fully satisfies every constraint in the brief; creative choices enhance the brief's intent.
anchors.3: Satisfies all hard constraints; minor creative deviations.
anchors.2: Misses one hard constraint or the overall direction is partially off.
anchors.1: Multiple hard constraints violated; the video barely relates to the brief.
anchors.0: The output is unrelated to the brief or no usable video produced.

dimensions.name: narrative_completeness
dimensions.description: Does the video tell a coherent story with a beginning, middle, and end? Is the narrative arc clear?

anchors.4: Clear and engaging narrative arc; beginning, middle, and end are all well-defined.
anchors.3: Narrative is coherent but one act is weak.
anchors.2: Fragmented; segments exist but no clear story progression.
anchors.1: Barely any narrative structure; random sequence of shots.
anchors.0: No narrative or no usable video.

dimensions.name: cross_shot_subject_consistency
dimensions.description: Does the core subject/character maintain visual consistency across at least 3 shots? Check clothing, appearance, identity.

anchors.4: Subject is perfectly consistent across all shots with the required minimum.
anchors.3: Minor inconsistency but clearly the same subject.
anchors.2: Noticeable inconsistency; could be different subjects.
anchors.0: No recognizable recurring subject or no usable video.

dimensions.name: visual_continuity
dimensions.description: Are shot transitions smooth? Are there jarring cuts, mismatched compositions, or broken visual flow?

anchors.4: All transitions are smooth; visual flow is professional.
anchors.3: Mostly smooth; one or two slightly jarring transitions.
anchors.2: Several jarring transitions; flow is uneven.

dimensions.name: visual_quality
dimensions.description: Overall visual quality: resolution, color, lighting, composition of individual shots. This replaces the old audio_video_coherence dimension which qwen-vl-max cannot judge (no audio understanding).

anchors.4: Professional visual quality; excellent color, lighting, composition.
anchors.3: Good quality; minor issues in one area.
